verdict.rationale: Brevo documents unlimited automated multi-step workflows. It also documents event-driven triggers: follow-up emails fire on signup, and engagement, purchase and behavior scores can trigger automations, with custom events tracked through JavaScript or REST APIs. Real-time event notifications are offered to automate workflows. All of this comes from marketing and pricing claims rather than in-depth rule-configuration docs. missing for 10: detailed documentation of trigger/condition rule definition (event types, branching logic), evidence of programmatic or AI-driven workflow creation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Create an unlimited number of automated, multi-step workflows to engage users at key moments along their journey.
Automatically trigger follow-up emails as soon as someone signs up.
Get contact scores based on engagement, purchases, and behaviors to trigger automations or create targeted segments.
Track custom user events and behaviors.
Receive real-time notifications about email events and automate workflows.
